## Latest parent transcript

**Path:** `C:\Users\valtt\.cursor\projects\c-Users-valtt-OneDrive-Godot\agent-transcripts\ef94eb64-2da7-4be5-b1ef-a1704d663ee0\ef94eb64-2da7-4be5-b1ef-a1704d663ee0.jsonl`  

It contains **only one JSONL record** (your May 11, 2026 message about governance/load and asking for a workflow audit). There is **no assistant or tool history** in that file yet, so it does **not** show context bloat in the transcript itself.

For **observable bloat patterns**, the nearest rich example in the same project is the parent thread:

**`C:\Users\valtt\.cursor\projects\c-Users-valtt-OneDrive-Godot\agent-transcripts\b5775442-0e11-4e9b-950f-184b6030b8cb\b5775442-0e11-4e9b-950f-184b6030b8cb.jsonl`**  
(~112 lines, May 8–10, 2026: bot plan → implementation → QA default wiring → further work).

---

## Concise diagnosis (with evidence patterns)

| Pattern | What shows up | Why it bloats context |
|--------|----------------|------------------------|
| **Structured progress feed every turn** | Repeated blocks like “Current step / Command or tool / Files / Next step / Stuck state” on many assistant messages | Fixed overhead **per turn**, scales linearly with chat length. |
| **Large `CreatePlan` payloads** | Full markdown plans (sections, mermaid, file lists, todos) stored in tool input | Entire plan is **re-injected** into the thread as assistant content. |
| **“Implement the plan…” handoff** | User messages repeat the same Cursor boilerplate and often the plan title; same thread chains **plan → implement → new plan → implement** | Same instructions and plan framing **stack** across phases. |
| **Heavy edit tools in history** | `StrReplace` (and similar) entries that embed **large `old_string` / `new_string`** chunks for docs | Diffs for big files are **hundreds–thousands of tokens** per step and stay in context. |
| **Parallel explore subagents** | Long `Subagent` `prompt` fields in the parent turn | Parent transcript retains **full subagent instructions** even before results. |
| **Long composite replies** | Summaries that re-list paths, commands, canon notes, then add a second narrative block | **Near-duplicate** recap in one or across adjacent turns. |

So: the **latest** parent file is still “empty” of assistant data; **bloat in practice** is visible in longer threads like `b5775442...`, driven by **plans + governance feed + large tool diffs + multi-phase work in one conversation**.

---

## Five practical recommendations for future chats

1. **Start a new chat per phase** (e.g. “plan only” → new chat “implement todo 1–3” → new chat “docs/QA wiring”). Avoids carrying **CreatePlan** bodies and early exploration forward.  
2. **Keep one canonical plan on disk** and in follow-ups say “implement the plan in `path/to/plan.md`” instead of pasting or re-attaching long plan text when the UI allows.  
3. **Prefer smaller, scoped reads** (symbols/sections) over multi-file full reads in the same turn, so tool results do not dump **entire scripts** unless needed.  
4. **Consolidate governance-style status into a single short line** when the rule set allows, instead of a **six-field template on every** assistant message (or only use the full template on long-running steps).  
5. **Avoid chaining unrelated large initiatives** (e.g. feature implementation + global QA policy + analytics) in **one** thread; each handoff adds **full new plans** and **full StrReplace** history to the same window.

If you want the diagnosis tied strictly to “whatever parent is newest once it has multiple turns,” re-run this check on `ef94eb64...jsonl` after the assistant has replied a few times; the patterns above are what to look for in the new lines.
